# 3d-triangle-plate

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Glossy triangular plates: a pyramid of four facet prisms, or one rounded triangle with circle nodes at its corners. Backdrop: White to pale grey. Items: 3 to 4. Default aspect: square.

## Colour palette

- Facet pyramid: four family colours (teal, lime, orange, red-orange), darker shade on the extruded side faces
- Corner nodes: silver to pale grey monochrome #E3E7ED to #A9B1BC, near-white face, dark charcoal text
- White to pale grey studio backdrop, soft shadow under the plate

## Visual elements

- Triangle 55 to 70 percent of the shorter canvas side, thick extruded edges with a glossy highlight
- Facets: four prisms, thin white gap between them so each reads as its own block
- Corner nodes: glossy rimmed discs 12 to 16 percent of the triangle height, flat line icons
- Leader lines thin and dark, ending in a small numeral or icon
- No text inside the centre of the facet pyramid except the facet labels

## Typography

- Family typography; facet labels bold white caps, option names bold caps in charcoal, descriptions light charcoal

## Composition rules

- Square canvas by default; triangle centred with text blocks in the four surrounding corners
- Facet pyramid: exactly four items, apex first
- Corner nodes: exactly three items, numbered clockwise from the top right
- More than four items, switch to 3d-hex-cluster or 3d-paper-tile

## Layout

### Structure

- One triangle fills 55 to 70 percent of the shorter canvas side, centred
- Facet pyramid: four triangular prisms, one point-up at the apex, three below (centre one point-down), each a different colour
- Corner nodes: one rounded triangular plate, a glossy circle node at each corner, numbered option labels along each edge
- Leader lines from each facet or node to its text block outside the triangle
- Optional small centre element (icon or apex arrow) on the corner-node plate

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Facet pyramid** | Four parts that build one whole | Four coloured prisms locked into one triangle, thick bevelled edges |
| **Corner nodes** | Three options, peers | One monochrome plate, three circle nodes with icons at the corners, option text along the edges |

### Visual Elements

- Extruded triangle edges 6 to 10 percent of the triangle height, glossy top-left highlight on every face
- Facet prisms in four family colours; corner-node plate in soft grey with a white inner bevel
- Circle nodes: rimmed glossy discs with a flat line icon
- Thin dark leader lines with a small numeral at the outer end
- Soft drop shadow under the whole triangle

### Text Placement

- Title at top right or top left, outside the triangle
- Facet label in bold caps on the face; description outside via the leader line
- Corner nodes: option numeral and name along the edge nearest the node, description outside the plate
- Numerals 01 to 04 at the outer end of each leader line

## Prompt fragment

```
Render as a polished corporate 3D infographic built on one glossy triangular plate: either four extruded triangular prisms in four family colours locked into one pyramid with thin white gaps, or a single soft-grey rounded triangle with a glossy rimmed circle node at each corner and numbered option names running along the edges. Thick bevelled edges, top-left highlights, a soft shadow beneath. Thin dark leader lines carry each item's description to the surrounding corners of the canvas. White to pale grey studio backdrop. Geometric sans-serif type. No hand-drawn lines, no paper texture, no cartoon characters, no photographic realism, no watermarks, no placeholder or lorem ipsum text. Clean premium business-template 3D.
```

## Best for

- Three or four pillars that form one whole
- Option triangles and trade-off triads
- Compact square social tiles
